chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who performs salat (prayer) and does not bring his hands out from his garment. He said: If he brings out his hands, that is good; and if he does not bring them out, then there is no harm.

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while keeping the hands inside one's garment?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a person performing salat (prayer) with his hands remaining inside his garment. Bringing the hands out is described as good, but leaving them inside does not invalidate the prayer and carries no objection.
